name: Aircraft Control and Radar
description: Aircraft control and air traffic control systems which are not provided on-board and used for the positioning and control of air traffic

name: Aircraft fuelling  signalling control and operations
description: The data which supports the supply and demand of fuel from the bunkering volume, quality testing and delivery to the aircraft.

name: Aviation Fuel logistics information
description: Everything which controls fuel demand and supply

name: Clinical operations information
description: All information which keep the hospital and clinics operating. This includes the scheduling of clinical and surgical time, the provision of all services which are not pharmaceutical or treatment related (handled by other specific information assets).

name: Court management
description: All information which supports the operation of the court excluding case material

name: Criminal cases
description: Any information which forms the basis of a criminal case brought by MIG

name: Detective Monitoring Events
description: All detective monitoring feeds to the SOC

name: Electrical Billing
description: The billing to payment flow on which the electrical system finance operates

name: Electrical control signalling
description: Generation and grid control signalling with direct implications for the safe operation of the grid.

name: Emergency communications
description: Radio and emergency communications provided by RF and GSM services.

name: Fisheries data
description: All information required to manage the fisheries, this includes licensing data, fish stocks, catches and market data.

name: Flight planning information
description: Air operations information which is used to plan flights, including: passenger manifest, cargo manifest, maintenance scheduling.

name: Generation Fuel logistics information
description: Everything which controls fuel demand and supply

name: Internal MIG user identity
description: Used for the authentication of users to internal systems

name: Maritime vessel tracking
description: Ship tracking information used for tracking all activity within our waters and fishery operations for our registered fleet.

name: Medical diagnostic information
description: Any information used by a clinician to support the diagnosis of a patient medical condition. This asset was created because of a heavy reliance on remote diagnostics and telemedicine.

name: Medical equipment calibration
description: X-Ray, drug delivery and other information related to the safe calibration and operation of any medical equipment used to treat patients.

name: MIG Financial payments data
description: All payment data which drive the movement of money between accounts both external and internal

name: MIG Government budgetary information
description: All the internal budgetary information

name: Offender/prisoner management
description: Management of convicted offenders within the prison and for the duration of their sentence

name: Passenger flight information
description: Flight information display for the general public

name: Patient medical records
description: All medical records which can be attributed to a patient

name: Personal Tax Information
description: Tax information which relates to personal tax and company tax

name: Pharmacy logistics and inventory
description: Everything associated with the provision of drugs. This includes supply and drug specific information

name: Port operations information
description: Anything related to the safe and efficient operation of the port. This includes container handing, berthing, labour management, logistics, and security

name: School operational information
description: Everything associated with the operation of the school, exam scheduling , transport, finances etc...

name: Scientific Environmental Data
description: All scientific data relating to the environment. Of very high value over a long period of time, usually irreplaceable. Usually published and shared

name: Student records
description: All student record. High impact for confidentiality due to privacy and legal

name: Water Billing
description: The billing to payment flow on which the water system finance operates
